question.prompt: Explain the role of NADH in oxidative phosphorylation.
question.follow_up: Now connect that electron flow to ATP synthase in one precise sentence.

source.excerpt: NADH donates high-energy electrons to the electron transport chain. Electron flow pumps protons across the inner mitochondrial membrane, creating the gradient that drives ATP synthase.
